mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns remain positive or neutral in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative or neutral in > 50% of instances when UNRATE decreases > 0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative or neutral in > 60% of instances when RSAFS increases for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in one month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive or neutral in > 50% of instances when INDPRO decreases > 2% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% in one month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3% in the same month, it signals a strong demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 5% and UNRATE decreases > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative or neutral in > 60% of instances when HOUST increases > 5% and UNRATE decreases > 0.3% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, which boosts liquidity and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative or neutral in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS decreases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in one month signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer spending and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative or neutral in > 50% of instances when PAYEMS increases > 200,000 in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth slows by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.5% in the same quarter, it signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth slows > 1% QoQ and UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 quarter
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive or neutral in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth slows > 1% QoQ and UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 quarter.
